1.w: And Jacob called to his sons and he said, “Gather together, and I will tell you⁺ what shall befall you⁺ in the last days.

2.w: Assemble yourselves, and listen, sons of Jacob; and listen to Israel your⁺ father.

3.w: Reuben, you [are] my firstborn, my might, and the first of my strength, exceeding in rank, and exceeding in power.

4.w: Uncontrolled as the waters, you shall not excel, because you went up [to the] bed of your father; then you defiled [it]—he went up [onto] my couch.

5.w: Simeon and Levi [are] brothers; instruments of violence [are] their swords.

6.w: Into their council let not my soul enter; to their assembly let not my honor be united; for in their anger they killed a man, and in their self-will they hamstrung an ox.

7.w: Cursed [be] their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

8.w: Judah—you, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand [shall be] on the neck of your enemies; sons of your father shall bow down to you.

9.w: Judah [is] a whelp of a lion; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. He crouched, he lay down as a lion, and like a lioness, who shall rouse him?

10.w: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until that he comes to Shiloh; and to him [is] the obedience of the peoples.

11.w: Binding his donkey to the vine, and the colt of his donkey to the choice vine; he washed in the wine his garment, and in the blood of grapes his robe.

12.w: His eyes [are] darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.

13.w: Zebulun shall dwell by the shore of the sea, and he [shall be] a haven for ships, and his border [shall be] to Sidon.

14.w: Issachar is a strong-boned donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.

15.w: And he saw rest, that [its was] good, and the land, that [it was] pleasant, and he extended his shoulder to bear [a burden], and he became a servant at forced labor.

16.w: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

17.w: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, a viper by the path, biting the heels of the horse, and its rider falls backward.

18.w: For Your salvation I have waited, YHWH.

19.w: Gad—a troop shall assault him, and he will attack the heel.

20.w: Out of Asher his bread [shall be] rich, and he shall give royal delicacies.

21.w: Naphtali [is] a doe set free, the one giving sayings of beauty.

22.w: Joseph [is] a son of fruitfulness, a son of fruitfulness by a spring; daughters march over the wall.

23.w: The masters of arrows—and they have embittered him, and shot and hated him.

24.w: And his bow remained in strength, and the arms of his hands were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob; from there [is] the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel.

25.w: By the God of your father, and He will help you, and by Shaddai, and He will bless you [with] blessings of the heavens above, blessings of the deep that lies beneath, blessings of breasts and womb.

26.w: The blessings of your father have excelled over the blessings of my ancestors up to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills; they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the prince of his brothers.

27.w: Benjamin is a wolf [that] tears; in the morning he shall devour prey, and in the evening he shall divide spoil.”

28.w: All these [are] two [and] ten tribes of Israel, and this [is] what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them—each one according to his own blessing, he blessed them.

29.w: And he commanded them and he said to them, “I am being gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that [is] in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

30.w: in the cave that [is] in the field of Machpelah, which [is] before the face of Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burial place.

31.w: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

32.w: The field and the cave that [is] in it [were] purchased from the sons of Heth.”

33.w: And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed and he expired, and he was gathered to his people.
